name: Glass whiteboard write
oneLiner: a clear glass board on steel standoffs swings in beside the speaker, the room's windows sliding across it as reflections; a rendered marker writes a heading in white, underlines it, writes the points by hand on twos, then loops the key word in red
say: when the speaker sketches a framework or a short list as if at a board ('the whole system is three things: find the pain, build the fix, charge for it'): cut in on the heading, the lines write as they're said, the red loop lands on the word they stress; set duration longer for slower delivery
